tools.name: mrx_status
tools.description: Check the current public sitemap/manifest, server capabilities and boundaries.

tools.name: mrx_search_guides
tools.description:
Search verified public MRX titles, headings and article text.
    Optional jurisdiction/topic filters are source-text matches, not legal conclusions.
    Coverage reports omissions. Do not include personal data in a research query.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search public MRX educational guides. Returns citable canonical document IDs.
    No private cases. Fetch each source before relying on it. An incomplete index
    produces an error rather than an apparently exhaustive compatibility response.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Fetch a verified public document by the canonical URL ID returned by search.
    Return source text, attribution and dates when available; never infer a review.

tools.name: mrx_read_page
tools.description:
Read one canonical public MRX page after sitemap, hash and indexability checks.
    Accepts only https://mineralrightsxchange.com/ URLs returned by search.
    Private routes, off-site URLs, queries, fragments and redirects are rejected.

tools.name: mrx_get_started
tools.description:
Read MRX's current public homepage and its source-linked next-step links.
    This does not submit a request, create a case, or perform a human review.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, mrx_read_page, mrx_get_started · Private data: search, fetch, mrx_read_page · Public sink: mrx_get_started.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, mrx_read_page, mrx_get_started · Private data: search, fetch, mrx_read_page · Public sink: mrx_get_started

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
